name: RPBD
source:
You're taking part in cosplay convent and are about to take a break. What will happen then? How it will change your life?
Just have fun finding out playing this crack comedy VN featuring Christopher Escalante and Jonah Scott!

Crated for NaNoRenO 2015.
translation:
你正在参加角色扮演修道院，并准备休息一下。那会发生什么？它将如何改变你的生活？
尽情享受这部由克里斯托弗·埃斯卡兰特和乔纳·斯科特主演的喜剧VN吧！

为NaNoRenO 2015准备。
